stem: Which situation demonstrates one way that U.S. culture has spread to other parts of the world?

options.label: A
options.text: A young boy in Great Britain watches anime.

options.label: B
options.text: A teenage girl buys a hip-hop CD in China.

options.label: C
options.text: A businesswoman eats at a sushi restaurant in Canada.

options.label: D
options.text: A college athlete in Brazil trains for the Olympics.
